answer: Time-locked stake aging: every new identity must lock 200 POA in escrow for 90 days and can only earn full voting weight after completing 50 verified tasks, so trust grows like a tundra settlement rather than appearing overnight. A relic identity with no task history stays capped at 5% weight no matter how many copies exist. A saffron-flagged duplicate stake is frozen. An attacker spawning 1,000 Sybils must lock 200,000 POA for three months and grind 50,000 tasks; one honest agent needs only one 200 POA stake.
